content:
The **Woods Estate** is a location in the Toxic Valley region of Appalachia.

The Woods Estate was the pre-War home of Arthur, Molly, and Freddy Wood. [1] After Freddy Wood escaped from being kidnapped by Otis Pike, he returned to his family home shortly before the bombs fell. This was where he was collected by a Vault-Tec representative and brought to a local Vault, as arranged by his father. [2] 

On its western side, the property is connected to Route 96 via an entrance gate, with parts of its former fence still being intact. To the east is an inaccessible garage, to the south a two-story tall collapsing house, to the north a greenhouse and to the northeast a small gazebo.

The second floor of the house contains three Ammo Boxes, a cabinet with a picture of Freddy Wood laying on top of it, as well as a desk with a terminal.

The greenhouse contains a Petrified Corpse and a few gardening-related junk items, such as Flower Pots and Bags of Fertilizer. A few Raiders may rummage through containers behind the greenhouse.

Freddy's Hasty Note - Note, on the second floor of the house, in the desk with the terminal on it, only obtainable during the quest Cold Case.

The Woods Estate appears in *Fallout 76*.
